title: docs(gen): document asynchronous media jobs (Prefer: respond-async)
author: SvirepyiBambr

gist.summary: Added an asynchronous media jobs guide to the Jobs section of the Scalar API reference. It shows how to submit image, video, audio and 3D requests with `Prefer: respond-async`, poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`, and download from `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/result`. The guide explains `202` responses, direct `200` responses for cached results, `409` for pending or failed jobs, and `404` for inaccessible, unknown or expired results. It also documents owner-only access, one generation and charge for identical requests, no charge for polling, and job records expiring 24 hours after completion. Streaming and text requests remain synchronous.
